pipeline.subtitle: Izigaba ezintathu kusukela emcabangweni wokuqala kuya enguqulweni yokugcina elungele ukushicilelwa — Series Room, Blueprint Room, kanye ne-Production Stage.

pillars.title: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-Series Room
pillars.body: Chaza uchungechunge lwakho noma isiteshi sakho se-YouTube kanye kuphela, bese i-SceneFlow yakha umhlaba wonke — okuhlanganisa indaba, abalingisi, kanye nohlu olungenamkhawulo lweziqephu — kusetshenziswa i-Reference Library eyabelwana ngayo, eqinisekisa ukuthi isiqephu ngasinye sihlala siqondene nomkhiqizo wakho.

steps.title: Qala ngomqondo wakho
steps.description: Faka umqondo noma incazelo enemininingwane yochungechunge lwakho noma isiteshi sakho se-YouTube. I-SceneFlow ikuguqula lokho kube yisisekelo esihleliwe nesilungele ukukhiqizwa — akudingeki ukuthi wazi indlela eyinkimbinkimbi yokubhala imiyalelo (prompt engineering).
steps.imagePlaceholder: Ukwamukelwa kochungechunge olusha — umqondo noma incazelo yesiteshi

steps.title: Bukeza isisekelo se-SceneFlow
steps.description: I-SceneFlow ikhiqiza isisekelo esisezingeni eliphezulu esilinganiselwe ngokusekelwe ekuhlaziyweni kwe-Audience Resonance. Funda noma ulalele isifinyezo esichazayo, bese usiqondisa ngendlela yakho.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Isisekelo sochungechunge — amaphuzu e-Audience Resonance kanye nesifinyezo esichazayo

steps.title: Dala iziqephu ezingenamkhawulo
steps.description: Dala iziqephu eziningi ngendlela indaba yakho edinga ngayo. Ngasinye sazo sithwala isimo esiyisisekelo sochungechunge lwakho, ngakho-ke abalingisi, isimo sendaba, kanye nomhlaba wayo kuhlala kungaguquki kusukela esiqephwini sokuqala kuya esiphethweni sesizini.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Uhlu lweziqephu — iziqephu ezingenamkhawulo ezikhiqizwe kusukela ohlakeni olukhulu lochungechunge

steps.title: Bukeza i-Reference Library
steps.description: Bhekabheka izinto ezabiwayo — abalingiswa, amazwi, izingubo, izindawo, kanye nezinsiza-kusebenza — ezidalwe futhi zagcinwa ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza, futhi ezisetshenziswa kabusha kuzo zonke iziqephu.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Igama lomtapo wolwazi le-SFAIREFERENCE okwabelwana ngalo — abalingiswa, amazwi, izindawo, izinto ezisetshenziswayo

steps.title: Qondisa Umsizi Wokubhala Ohlakaniphile
steps.description: Lungisa kabusha uchungechunge noma isiqephu esithile ngokukhuluma noma ngokuthayipha imiyalelo yakho. Umsizi Obhalayo Ohlakaniphile ubhala kabusha imibhalo yobungcweti ngokushesha — akukho sidingo sokuqala ekhasini elingenalutho noma sokwakha imiyalelo eyinkimbinkimbi.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Umsizi Wombhali Ohlakaniphile — ukuqondisa ngamazwi noma ngombhalo mayelana nochungechunge neziqephu

steps.title: Qala ukukhiqiza ngokuchofoza kanye
steps.description: Uma isiqephu sibonakala silungile, qala ukukhiqizwa kwaso ngokuchofoza kanye bese ungena ngqo ohlelweni oluqondiswayo lwe-Production Stage.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Qala ukukhiqiza isiqephu esikhethiwe ngokuchofoza kanye

pillars.title: SFAIBLUEPRINT_IGAMA_LE_GUMBI
pillars.body: I-Blueprint Room iwuhlelo lwakho olunzulu lwefilimu — oluhlanganisa isifinyezo sendaba, izigaba ezibalulekile, abalingiswa, umoya wendaba, kanye nesitayela — oluhlaziywe kusengaphambili kusetshenziswa i-Audience Resonance Analysis; lokhu kwenza ukwazi ukuvumela indaba ezoba nomthelela omuhle ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukukhiqizwa ngisho nohlaka olulodwa lwefilimu.

steps.title: Bukeza i-Blueprint eyisisekelo.
steps.description: Vula uhlaka oluyisisekelo lochwepheshe oluhlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kokusebenza kahle kwalo kubantu okuhlosiwe (audience resonance). Funda noma ulalele incazelo echaziwe ukuze uzwe kahle ukuthi kungani lusebenza ngale ndlela.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Isisekelo se-Blueprint — ukwelashwa okune-score se-Audience Resonance

steps.title: Qondisa Umsizi Wokubhala Ohlakaniphile
steps.description: Thuthukisa isifinyezo sendaba, izigaba ezibalulekile, abalingiswa, nokunye ngokukhuluma noma ngokubhala imiyalelo yakho. Umsizi Obhalayo Ohlakaniphile ulungisa uhlaka lwendaba ngokushesha — ngaphandle kwesidingo sokwakha imiyalelo eyinkimbinkimbi.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Umsizi Wokubhala Ohlakaniphile — ukuhlela isifinyezo sendaba, izigaba ezibalulekile zendaba, kanye nabalingiswa

steps.title: Buyekeza izizathu
steps.description: Vula isigaba esithi "Reasoning" ukuze uthole incazelo enobuhlakani nge-Blueprint yamanje — okungukuthi, umqondo wendaba ongemuva kwesigaba ngasinye kanye nokukhethwa kwabalingiswa.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Iphaneli yezizathu — incazelo enobuhlakani ye-Blueprint

steps.title: Qala ukukhiqiza uma usukulungele
steps.description: Uma indaba isihamba kahle, qala ukuyikhiqiza — futhi yonke inqubo yokusebenza izothatha lowo mlingiswa noma isitayela esiyingqayizivele esivunyiwe, ngaphandle kokuphambuka kukho.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Vula i-Production Stage — isigaba sokuhlola ukulungela esisuselwa epulani evunyiwe

pillars.title: Isigaba Sokukhiqiza se-SFAI
pillars.header: Kusukela embhalweni kuya kumkhiqizo wokugcina oshicilelwe
pillars.body: I-Production Stage yenza inqubo yokukhiqiza ngezinhlelo eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa — umbhalo, umsindo, ozimele (frames), nevidiyo — ngokusebenzisana ne-Intelligent Assistant Director, i-Screening Room, kanye nezindlela zokusakaza ngezilimi eziningi ezikuyisa kusukela embhalweni ogunyaziwe kuya kumkhiqizo wokugcina we-4K oseyilungele ukushicilelwa.

steps.title: Buyekeza umbhalo oyisisekelo
steps.description: Qala ngombhalo oyisisekelo ochwepheshile ohlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwe-Audience Resonance. Funda noma ulalele ukuhlaziywa okuchaziwe ukuze wazi ukuthi yini ephumelelayo ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise ikhredithi.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Umbhalo oyisisekelo — Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Audience Resonance kanye nesifinyezo esichazayo

steps.title: Thuthukisa isigcawu ngasinye
steps.description: Sebenzisa i-Intelligent Assistant Writer ukuze uthuthukise umbhalo wesikrini isigcawu ngesigcawu — cije izingxoxo, ulungise ukuhamba kwesigcawu, futhi wenze izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ngokuchofoza kanye nje, kungaba ngezwi noma ngombhalo.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Umsizi Wokubhala Ohlakaniphile — ukuthuthukiswa kombhalo wesikrini ngokwezigcawu

steps.title: Yakha i-Reference Library
steps.description: Dala noma ubuyekeze i-Reference Library usebenzisa izinhlamvu, amazwi, izingubo, izindawo, kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswayo—kungaba ezihlelelwe umbhalo, ezenzelwe wena ngokukhethekile, noma ezilayishiwe. Hlela izithombe eziyisisekelo ngqo—akukho ukukhiqizwa kabusha okungahleliwe okufana nokomshini wokugembula.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Reference Library — abalingiswa, amazwi, izingubo, izindawo, izinsiza-kusebenza

steps.title: Khiqiza umsindo
steps.description: Khiqiza izingxoxo, ukulandisa, imiphumela yemisindo (SFX), kanye nomculo usebenzisa ama-ejenti ahlukahlukene kuzo zonke izigcawu, i-ejenti eyodwa ngesigcawu ngasinye, noma isinyathelo ngesinyathelo — konke ngamazwi anjengawesikhulumi sendabuko ngezilimi ezingaphezu kuka-70.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Audio Agent — zonke izigcawu, isigcawu esisodwa, noma isigaba ngesigaba

steps.title: Khiqiza futhi uhlele ozime
steps.description: Khiqiza amafreyimu esigaba (beat frames) usebenzisa i-Run All Agents ne-Stills Agent esigcawini ngasinye, noma isigaba ngesigaba, bese uhlela noma yiliphi ifreyimu usebenzisa i-Intelligent Assistant Director (IAD) — vele uchaze ushintsho olufunayo.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Finyelela isigqi sezithombe ngokuhlela okwenziwa yi-SFAI Intelligent Assistant Director.

steps.title: Bukeza i-animatic
steps.description: Dlala i-animatic ephelele — amafreyimu, izingxoxo, imiphumela yomsindo (SFX), kanye nomculo — ngaphakathi kwegumbi lokubuka elisebenzisanayo (Screening Room), bese wabelana ngesixhumanisi sokuthola imibono ngaphandle kokukhipha ifayela.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Screening Room — ukubuyekezwa nokwabelana nge-animatic exhumanayo

steps.title: Khiqiza ividiyo
steps.description: Guqula ozimele abavunyiwe babe ukunyakaza usebenzisa i-Video Agent, kungaba yisigcawu ngasinye noma isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Phinda uthathe noma yisiphi isithombe usebenzisa i-Intelligent Assistant Director — ngaphandle kokulinda imiphumela engapheli ekhiqizwa ngokungahleliwe.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-Video Agent okuhlanganisa nokuphindwa kwe-IAD

steps.title: Hlela ku-Mixer
steps.description: Lungisa kahle isigcawu ngasinye ku-Mixer — imibhalo, ukunquma, ukufaka amazwi, izendlalelo, kanye nokulinganisa umsindo — ukuqedela umsebenzi ngendlela ephephile yomkhiqizo ngaphandle kokuphuma estudiyo.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Isihlanganisi — imibhalo, ukunquma, ukufaka izwi elisha, nezilawuli zomsindo

steps.title: Khiqiza futhi ubuyekeze izigcawu
steps.description: Khiqiza izigcawu zakho, bese uzibuyekeza futhi wabelane ngazo nge-Screening Room ukuze uthole imvume eqinisekisiwe ngaphambi kokuhlanganiswa kokugcina.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Izigcawu ezikhiqiziwe zibuyekeziwe futhi zabelwe ku-Screening Room

steps.title: Khiqiza imifudlana yezilimi eziningi
steps.description: Dala izinguqulo zomsindo (ezifana ne-dubbing noma ukuvumelanisa izindebe nezwi) kusukela kuleyo nguqulo eyodwa evunyiwe — finyelela ezimakethe ezingaphezu kuka-70 ngaphandle kokuthi uphinde uqophe ngisho nohlaka olulodwa.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Ukusakaza ngezilimi eziningi — okufakwe amazwi (dubbed) nokuvumelaniswe nokunyakaza kwezindebe ngokwendawo

steps.title: Qedela bese ushicilela
steps.description: Lungisa umkhiqizo wokugcina ube yifayela eliyinhloko bese uwushicilela — izithombe ezincane (thumbnails), izihloko, kanye nezincazelo ezikhiqizwe ngokuzenzakalelayo sezilungele isiteshi sakho se-YouTube kanye nezinye izinkundla.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Ukucutshungulwa kokugcina nokushicilelwa ku-YouTube ngokuchofoza kanye

rooms.label: SFAISERIES_IsikhathiSegumbi
rooms.promise: I-Series Room yindawo lapho kuqala khona isizini. Abalingiswa abafanayo nendaba efanayo kuqhubeka kuwo wonke iziqephu ozengezayo. Yifunde, uyilalele, futhi uyiqondise ngaphambi kokuba isiqephu sivuleke ku-Blueprint Room. Ifilimu engenayo isizini ingayeqa le ndawo.

features.title: Uchungechunge Olusha
features.description: Qala lapha. Chaza uchungechunge oluhlosile ngamazwi akho. Isici esithi "Clarify and Confirm" (Cacisa futhi Uqinisekise) sisebenza nawe kulowo mbono kuze kube yilapho isifinyezo sesilungile, bese isici esithi "Generate Series" (Dala Uchungechunge) sibhala uhlaka oluyisisekelo. Uchungechunge olusha luqala ngeziqephu ezinhlanu, futhi ungangeza ezinye.
features.screenshot: Dala Uchungechunge Olusha — inhloso, Cacisa futhi Uqinisekise, Khiqiza Uchungechunge

items.title: Inhloso yakho
items.description: Chaza ukuthi lolu chungechunge luyini, kubandakanya uhlobo lwalo, izethameli, kanye nesitayela sobuciko.

items.title: Phinda
items.description: Isici esithi "Clarify and Confirm" sicwengisisa isifinyezo kanye nawe ngaphambi kokuba kukhiqizwe noma yini.

items.title: Isisekelo
items.description: I-Generate Series ibhala isizini ozoyibuyekeza, eqala ngeziqephu ezinhlanu.

features.title: Bukeza uhlaka lokuqala
features.description: Funda isifinyezo, noma ucindezele inkinobho ethi "Lalela". Bese ufunda iziqephu, noma uzilalele. Ukungaguquguquki kuyawahlanganisa amagatsha endaba, kanti ukuqhubeka okuhlelekile kugcina abalingisi, izindawo, izinto ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nezimo ezabiwa yilezo ziqephu.
features.screenshot: Uhlu Oluphelele, Iziqephu, Ukungaguquguquki, Ukuqhubeka — Abalingisi, Izindawo, Izinto Zokusetshenziswa, Izimo

items.title: Funda noma ulalele
items.description: Isifinyezo neziqephu kungafundwa, noma kulalelwe kusetshenziswa inketho ethi "Lalela".

items.title: Ukungaguquguquki
items.description: Isitayela sokubukeka, izigameko ezibalulekile, kanye nemicu yendaba kuhambisana nenkathi.

items.title: Ukuqhubeka
items.description: Abalingisi, izindawo, izinto ezisetshenziswayo kanye nezimo yilezo ezifanayo ezisetshenziswa kuzo zonke iziqephu.

features.title: Igama elichaza ukuhambisana nemizwa yezithameli
features.description: Sebenzisa i-Audience Resonance uma ufuna ukuthola ulwazi mayelana nesizini. Hlola amaphuzu kanye nokuhlaziywa kwawo. Sebenzisa ulwazi olungaguqulwa lube yisenzo (Actionable Insight) kuphela uma ukhetha ukwenza njalo; akukho okuzoshintsha ochungechungeni kuze kube yilapho wenza lokho.
features.screenshot: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Audience Resonance, kulandelwe imininingwane engasetshenziswa (Actionable Insights), engakasetshenziswa.

items.title: Ukufunda
items.description: Izikolo nokuhlaziya kukhombisa lokho okusebenzayo kubantu obakhombile.

items.title: Ongakukhetha
items.description: Ulwazi olungasetshenziswa luyalushintsha uchungechunge kuphela uma ulusebenzisa.

features.title: Umqondisi Wochungechunge
features.description: Qondisa uchungechunge lonke ngamazwi akho, kungaba ngawomlomo noma abhalwe phansi. Ukhetha ushintsho kanye nokugxila, bese ukwamukela lokho. Isiphakamiso singaba usizo, kanti izingxenye zendaba ezingahlobene zihlala zinjalo.
features.screenshot: Umqondisi Wochungechunge — ukuqondisa, ukugxila, ukwamukela

items.title: Amazwi akho
items.description: Khuluma noma uthayiphe ushintsho, futhi uma uthanda, uluqondise kuphela endabeni, kubalingiswa, kokuqukethwe yisiqephu, emoyeni wendaba, noma endaweni eyenzeka kuyo.

items.title: Uyakwamukela
items.description: Akukho lutho olushintshayo kuze kube yilapho ukwamukela, kanti izingxenye zendaba ezingahlobene zihlala zinjalo.

items.title: Isincomo
items.description: Izincomo zingasiza, kanti usengakwazi ukuzikhethela ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyigcina.

features.title: Qondisa lesi sigaba
features.description: Vula isiqephu bese uqondisa lelo hora kuphela. Khulisa izinga lobunzima noma ujulise indaba, bese ukusebenzisa lokho. Ezinye iziqephu zihlala zinjengoba zinjalo.
features.screenshot: Iziqephu — Qondisa lesi siqephu, ezinye iziqephu zihlala zinjengoba zinjalo

items.title: Isiqephu esisodwa
items.description: Lokhu kusebenzisa ushintsho kuleso siqephu kuphela.

items.title: Isizini iyaqhubeka
items.description: Ezinye iziqephu zishiywe njengoba zinjalo.

features.title: Qala isiqephu
features.description: Uma isiqephu sesikulungele, qala iphrojekthi yaso. Uhlaka, isifinyezo, kanye nezigaba ezibalulekile (beats) kuhamba nakho kuya ku-Blueprint Room. Abalingisi kanye nomhlaba wendaba sekuyaziwa kakade.
features.screenshot: Qala iphrojekthi — uhlaka kanye nabalingisi sebekhona esiqeshini

items.title: Qala iphrojekthi
items.description: I-Start Project ivula leso siqephu ku-Blueprint Room.

items.title: Sekwaziwa kakade
items.description: Uhla oluyisisekelo, isifinyezo, izigaba ezibalulekile kanye nabalingisi kuhamba nakho.

rooms.label: SFAIBLUEPRINT_IGAMA_LE_GUMBI
rooms.promise: I-Blueprint Room yindawo lapho ucwengisisa khona indaba ngaphambi kokubhala umbhalo wemidlalo (script) wemizuzu engama-90. Qala ngesiqephu sochungechunge noma ngephrojekthi entsha. Hlela izigaba zendaba kanye nabalingisi lapha, ukuze i-Production Stage ingadingi ukuphinde ikwakhe konke lokho kusukela ekuqaleni.

features.title: Qala i-Blueprint
features.description: Qala ngesiqephu sochungechunge, noma uqale iphrojekthi entsha. Isiqephu sochungechunge sifika sihlanganise uhlaka, isifinyezo, kanye nezigaba ezibalulekile (beats). Iphrojekthi entsha iqala lapho uchaza inhloso, usebenzisa isici esithi "Validate & Enhance with AI," bese ukhetha inketho ethi "Generate Blueprint."
features.screenshot: Isiqephu sochungechunge sesiyaziwa, noma Qala Iphrojekthi Yakho — inhloso, Qinisekisa futhi Uthuthukise nge-AI, Khiqiza i-Blueprint

items.title: Isiqephu sochungechunge
items.description: Isiqephu sochungechunge siqala ngohlaka lwaso, isifinyezo, kanye nezigaba ezibalulekile zendaba (beats) okusuke sekunanyathiselwe kakade.

items.title: Iphrojekthi entsha
items.description: Isici esithi "Start Your Project" sithatha inhloso, bese siyiqinisekisa futhi siyithuthukise kusetshenziswa i-AI, bese sikhiqiza i-Blueprint.

features.title: Qondisa isigqi
features.description: Vula ithebhu ethi "Beats" bese ulalela uhlu lwezigaba (beat sheet). Lungiselela kahle lezi zigaba lapha, ngoba yizo eziqondisa ukwakhiwa kombhalo. Lezi zigaba zitholakala lapha kuphela. I-Production Stage iguqula isigaba ngasinye sibe yisahluko.
features.screenshot: Ithebhu ethi Beats, enenketho ethi Lalela

items.title: Uhlu olulodwa lwezigaba zendaba
items.description: Imigqi ikhona lapha kuphela.

items.title: Ukwakhiwa kombhalo wohlelo
items.description: Ama-beat yiwona aqhuba ukwakhiwa kombhalo, ngakho-ke athuthukiswa ngaphambi kwe-Production Stage.

items.title: Izahluko
items.description: I-Production Stage iguqula isigqi ngasinye sibe yisahluko.

features.title: Qondisa abalingisi nezindawo zokuqopha
features.description: Vula isigaba esithi Characters bese uhlela abalingisi. Vula isigaba esithi Setting kuthebhu ethi Story bese uhlela izindawo ezihambisana nabo. Abalingisi banomthelela ekwakhiweni kombhalo (script), ngakho kokubili kumiswa ngaphambi kokuba i-Production Stage idinge ukulungisa kabusha umbhalo.
features.screenshot: Ithebhu yezinhlamvu, bese kuba yindawo yesigameko endabeni

items.title: Abadlali
items.description: Ithebhu ethi 'Characters' imele abalingisi, futhi labo balingisi banomthelela ekwakhiweni kombhalo womdlalo.

items.title: Izindawo
items.description: Izindawo yizo ezakha isimo sendaba kuthebhu ethi Story.

items.title: Ngaphambi kombhalo
items.description: Ukuqondisa kokubili lapha kugwema ukwenziwa kabusha okukhulu kombhalo (script) ku-Production Stage.

features.title: Umqondisi we-Blueprint
features.description: Umqondisi wamukela ushintsho ngamagama akho, kungaba ngawomlomo noma abhalwe phansi. Gxilisa ukulungisa kwakho ezigabeni (beats), kubalingiswa, noma endabeni, bese ubuka kuqala izinguquko. Akukho okushintshayo kuze kube yilapho ususebenzisa lezo zinguquko.
features.screenshot: Umqondisi — ukuqondisa, ukugxila, ukubuka kuqala, ukusebenzisa izinguquko

items.title: Amazwi akho
items.description: Khuluma noma uthayiphe ushintsho, bese ugxila ezigabeni (beats), kubalingiswa, noma endabeni.

items.title: Ukubuka kuqala
items.description: Ukukhiqiza ukulungiswa okulinganiselayo kukhombisa ushintsho ngaphambi kokuba ulusebenzise.

items.title: Uyisifaka
items.description: Akukho okushintshayo kuze kube yilapho usebenzisa izinguquko.

features.title: Igama elichaza ukuhambisana nemizwa yezithameli
features.description: Londoloza izethameli, bese wenza ukuhlaziya. Uzobona amaphuzu kanye nezincomo. Akukho okushintshayo ohlelweni oluyisisekelo (blueprint) kuze kube yilapho usebenzisa isincomo ku-Blueprint Director.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance — izethameli ezilondoloziwe, amaphuzu, izincomo ezingasetshenziswanga

items.title: Ukufunda
items.description: Londoloza izethameli, bese uhlaziya, ufunde amaphuzu nezincomo.

items.title: Ongakukhetha
items.description: Isincomo sishintsha uhlaka kuphela uma usisebenzisa ku-Blueprint Director.

features.title: Iya ku-Production Stage
features.description: Yiya ku-Production Stage uma uhlaka lwendaba, izigaba zayo, kanye nabalingisi sebekhethiwe. Umbhalo womdlalo wemizuzu engu-90 wakhiwa kusukela kuleli bhodi. Akudingeki ukuthi uhlaka lwendaba luphinde lwakhiwe kabusha ku-Production Stage.
features.screenshot: Iya ku-Production Stage — uhlaka lwendaba, izigaba zayo, kanye nabalingisi sekumisiwe kakade.

items.title: Ukudluliselwa
items.description: Iya ku-Production Stage ukuze uvule umbhalo ovela kulo mdwebo oyisisekelo.

rooms.promise: Lesi yisigaba lapho uhlaka oluvunyiwe luphenduka khona umkhiqizo wokugcina obonakalayo. Lawula izindleko ngokusebenzisa izindlela zakho zokulawula kanye nohlelo olucacile. Khiqiza iziqeshana, uzihlanganise, udale izinhlobo ngezilimi ezahlukene, bese uthumela isigcawu, isahluko, ifayela eliyinhloko (master), noma ividiyo yokukhangisa.

rooms.label: Igama Legumbi Lokuhlola le-SFAI
rooms.promise: Igumbi lokubukela (screening room) yindawo lapho inguqulo yokugcina yevidiyo ibukwa, ihlolwa, futhi ikhishwa khona. Uhlelo olulodwa lokudlala (player) luqukethe i-Pre-Vis, izigcawu, izahluko, ifayela eliyinhloko (master), i-promo, kanye nohlelo ngalunye lolimi, ukuze inguqulo enomsindo ohunyushiwe (dub) ifane ncamashi nenguqulo ekhiqizwe ngumuntu ohlanganisa imisindo (Mixer). Yabelana ngesixhumanisi esisodwa sokudlala nokufaka imibono ngesithombe. Shicilela isigcawu esithatha imizuzu engu-3–5, isahluko esithatha imizuzu engu-8–12, ifayela eliyinhloko, noma i-promo uma leyo ngxenye isilungile, bese uqhubeka nokusebenza kwezinye izingxenye.

features.title: Umdlali oyedwa

Khetha uhlelo lolimi ukuze uzwe leyo nguqulo — kungaba nge-dubbing, ukuvumelanisa izindebe (lip-sync), noma ukwenziwa kabusha kwesithombe ngasinye. Isidlali sikhombisa uhlobo olufanayo olukhiqizwe yi-Mixer.

metadata.title: SceneFlow Studio - Ukwenziwa kwamavidiyo kusetshenziswa i-AI
metadata.description: Guqula imibono yakho ibe amavidiyo asezingeni eliphezulu usebenzisa uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo lokusebenza olusekelwe kubuchwepheshe be-AI.

hero.eyebrow: Ukukhiqizwa kwamafilimu nochungechunge okwenziwa ngobuchwepheshe obuzisebenzelayo
hero.headline: Kusukela enhlansi yokuqala kuya emsebenzini ophelele wobungcweti.
hero.subheadline: I-SceneFlow iyindlela eyodwa ehleliwe yokusebenza. Uqondisa indaba, abalingisi, kanye nomoya womsebenzi. Yakha i-Blueprint, igcine ukulandelana okufanele, idlale i-animatic ephelele, futhi ihlanganise umkhiqizo wokugcina — ngaphandle kokuzama izinto ngokungahleliwe noma ukusebenzisa uhlu lweziqeshana ezingahlelekile.
hero.ctaSupportingLine: Isitudiyo esihlanganisa konke okudingekayo ukuze udale, ukhiphe, futhi usabalalise izindaba zakho. Landa ifayela eliyinhloko (master) bese ulihambisa noma kuphi — noma ushicilele izingxenye ezinde nezahluko ku-{longForm}, futhi ukhangise ngama-trailer ku-{shorts}.
hero.ctaNetworkInvite: Amaphrojekthi avelele angafaka isicelo sokujoyina inethiwekhi ye-SceneFlow, evulekele labo abamenyiwe kuphela.
hero.ctaToolStack: Bona indlela okuthatha ngayo indawo yeqoqo lakho lamathuluzi.

chips.label: Kusukela emcabangweni kuya esicini
chips.detail: Thuthukisa imibono ibe yimibhalo yesikrini ethatha imizuzu engama-90 ngaphakathi ku-Blueprint Room. Chaza abalingiswa, ubuciko, kanye nezigaba ezibalulekile zendaba (beats), bese uvumela ukuhlaziywa kwe-Audience Resonance ukuthi kucwengisise indaba yakho ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuyiqopha.

chips.label: Qondisa ngokuqondile nangenhloso, hhayi ngezikhumbuzo.
chips.detail: Khuluma ulimi lwefilimu usebenzisa izinsiza ezihlakaniphile eziqonda indlela ofuna izinto zenziwe ngayo. I-Reference Library iqinisekisa ukuthi abalingisi, izingubo, kanye nezindawo ozikhethele zona kuhlala kungashintshi ukuze kube nokuhambisana okuphelele.

chips.label: Ukukhiqiza okuqhutshwa ngama-ejenti
chips.detail: Sheshisa inqubo yokudala izikhathi ezi-5 ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlakaniphile ezakha izigcawu ezinokubukeka okuhlukene okungu-30 ngemuva. Lungisa futhi uthuthukise umsebenzi wakho ngokukhululeka esigabeni sokuhlola, bese ushicilela umbono wakho wokugcina ngekhwalithi ephezulu kakhulu nemangalisayo.

chips.label: Hlola, Sebenzisana, Khipha
chips.detail: Yabelana ngenqubekelaphambili esigabeni ngasinye esibalulekile—kusukela kuma-audio animatic kuya kumkhiqizo wokugcina—ku-Screening Room. Kusabalalise njengamafilimu amafushane noma amafilimu agcwele ngezilimi eziningi ukuze kufinyelelwe ezilalelini zomhlaba wonke.

twoModes.title: Uhlelo olulodwa lokugeleza komsebenzi. Hhayi inqwaba yamathuluzi.
twoModes.subtitle: SceneFlow replaces single-clip generators and a pile of separate docs, editors, and re-renders. Build the series or the 90-minute master, then publish a scene or a chapter when you are ready to earn.

comparison.caption: Fragmented tools beside one SceneFlow pipeline.

directControl.title: Qondisa indaba. Vumela ama-ejenti enze umsebenzi wokunikeza izinkomba.
directControl.subtitle: Uqondisa isithombe noma ividiyo usebenzisa ulimi olulula. Imiyalelo yokuqondisa ichaza ukuthi isithombe esinganyakazi noma isiqeshana sevidiyo kufanele sibe njani. Izimpawu zomculo nokulandisa kuhambisana nesigqi. Buka uhlaka oluyisisekelo (i-animatic), ulungise isithombe uma kukhona okungalungile, bese kuthi kuphela lapho-ke usebenzise imali ekwenzeni izinto zinyakaze.

comparison.caption: Umyalelo womqondisi, isikhumbuzi sokuqala ividiyo, kanye nomculo nokulandisa okuhambisana nesigqi esifanayo.

publishCut.title: Khiphela noma kuphi. Sebenzisa i-Premiere ku-SceneFlow uma usuyitholile.
publishCut.subtitle: Download a master and ship it yourself, or publish finished scenes and chapters to {longForm} and cut trailers for {shorts} — without waiting on the whole cut. Before anything hits the public feed, run drafts or your final master through the Screening Room. Standout projects can apply for the invite-only SceneFlow Network; it is a curated accelerator, not an open storefront.

paths.outcome: Khipha umkhiqizo ngesikhathi — yeka ukuwudala kabusha kuwo wonke amathuluzi
paths.narrative: Unayo indaba, kodwa isiqephu ngasinye sidinga ukuthi uphinde ukhiphe amafayela (assets), ufake imiyalelo emisha, futhi uthembe ukuthi ukulandelana kwezinto kuzohlala kuhlelekile. I-SceneFlow ixhumanisa i-Series Room, i-Blueprint Room, kanye ne-Production Stage endaweni eyodwa yokusebenzela — ngakho-ke uvumela ukubukeka kwento esigabeni sokubuka kuqala (pre-vis), wakhe isigcawu ngesigcawu, bese ukhiqiza iziqephu ezihambisanayo ngesikhathi esibekiwe, kunokuba uqale phansi ukwakha yonke into.
useCases: Amafilimu okubhala ngamaqiniso nochungechunge lwamafilimu okubhala ngamaqiniso

example.challengeDescription: Unombhalo omuhle kakhulu, kodwa ukufunda amathuluzi ayisithupha ahlukene okudala nokuhlela — noma ukubhajwa emijikelezweni yamavidiyo ephindaphindeka ngokungapheli — kubambezela inqubo yokulayisha ividiyo ngayinye. Impumelelo yochungechunge lwamavidiyo ku-YouTube kanye nesivinini esidingekayo ezinhlelweni ezifana ne-YouTube TV kudinga ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwe ngokushesha okukhulu kunalokho okungenziwa ngamathuluzi e-AI ahlukene futhi angahlelekile.
example.solutionDescription: Khiqiza uchungechunge lweziqephu namavidiyo amafushane abamba amehlo usuka esitudiyweni esisodwa — kusukela ekwakhiweni kokuqala kokubonwayo okugxile ekuhlelweni kwezigcawu, ukuqinisekisa ukugeleza okuhlelekile kochungechunge, kuya ekulungiseni imikhiqizo yokugcina esilungele ukushicilelwa emkhakheni wabadali bokuqukethwe oholwa yi-YouTube.
example.win: Shintsha usuke ekulayisheni okuvela ngezikhathi ezithile uye ohlelweni lokukhiqiza oluthembekile, oludinga umzamo noma izindlela ezingeziwe ezincane.

paths.label: Ithimba langaphakathi
paths.outcome: Shintsha izinqubo zabahlinzeki ezihamba kancane — lawula uhlobo lomkhiqizo kanye nesabelomali
paths.narrative: Izicelo zangaphakathi zamavidiyo ziyaqongeleleka ngenkathi amanani aphakanyiswa yizinkampani zangaphandle enza umsebenzi uthathe isikhathi eside, kanti nemihlahlandlela yomkhiqizo iyashintsha-shintsha njalo uma kwenziwa izinguquko. I-SceneFlow ihlanganisa imisebenzi yokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi (L&D), ezokuxhumana, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwamavidiyo achaza imikhiqizo ibe uhlelo olulodwa oluhleliwe — ithimba lakho liba namandla aphelele phezu kombhalo, uhlaka lokuqala olubonakalayo (pre-vis), kanye nomkhiqizo wokugcina, ngaphandle kokudinga ukuqasha isitudiyo noma ukulinda abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bangaphandle.
useCases: Ukufunda Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi kanye Nokuthotshelwa Kwemithetho Ezinkampanini

example.challengeTitle: Umsebenzi Ongaqediwe Womhlinzeki kanye Nokuchezuka Kwesithunzi Somkhiqizo
example.challengeDescription: Amaqembu ezokuxhumana, ezokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi (L&D), kanye nawokumaketha achitha amasonto elinde amavidiyo avela ezinkampanini zangaphandle — noma abhekane nenqwaba yamathuluzi adidayo ngaphandle kohlelo oluzinzile olungasetshenziswa ngaphakathi enkampanini. Yonke le migwaqo iholela ekungabini bikho kobunye obuqhubekayo ekumeleleni uhlobo lwenkampani (branding) kanye nokuma kwemikhankaso.
example.solutionDescription: Yabela abasebenzi umsebenzi wokukhiqiza ividiyo ngaphakathi kwesabelomali esicacile samakhredithi — kusetshenziswa izifanekiso zomkhiqizo, kutholakala imvume ngaphambi kokukhiqizwa kwenguqulo yokugcina, futhi kungabikho zindleko zezinsuku zabasebenzi noma izigaba zokuhlela ezingenamkhawulo wesikhathi.
example.win: Khipha izinto zokuqeqesha, ezokuxhumana namavidiyo emikhankaso ngokohlelo lwakho — hhayi ngokulinda uhlu lwemisebenzi engakaqedwa yomhlinzeki.

paths.label: Indawo yokukhiqiza
paths.outcome: Guqula umkhakha othile ube umkhiqizo ngokusebenzisa inqubo ephindaphindekayo yokwamukela umsebenzi nokuletha umphumela.
paths.narrative: Umsebenzi wokwenza amavidiyo ngokwezidingo zamakhasimende uba nenzuzo kuze kube yilapho ikhasimende ngalinye seliba yinto eyenzeka kanye kuphela — okudinga amathuluzi amasha, izinqubo ezintsha zokudlulisa umsebenzi, kanye nenzuzo enyamalalayo ngenxa yokubuyekeza umsebenzi. I-SceneFlow iguqula umkhakha wakho okhethekile ube umkhiqizo: inqubo yokwamukela umsebenzi ephindaphindekayo, izifanekiso ezingasetshenziswa ngaphansi kwegama lakho (white-label templates), ukulandisa okwenziwa ngezwi elilingiswe ngobuchwepheshe, kanye nendlela ecacile kusukela ekuqaleni (imininingwane yomsebenzi) kuya ekulethweni kwevidiyo ye-MP4.
useCases: Izifanekiso zesitudiyo ezingenziwa ngaphansi kwegama lakho
Uhambo lokubuka izindawo nezakhiwo kanye nezindawo zokwamukela izivakashi

example.challengeTitle: Izixazululo Eziklanyelwe Imikhakha Ethile, Akukho Sis-temu Esiphindekayo
example.challengeDescription: Amakhasimende abhekene nezindaba zempilo (memoirs), ukulondoloza ifa, ezindlu nomhlaba, kanye nezemfundo adinga imisebenzi eqedwa ngokushesha — kodwa iphrojekthi ngayinye iqala phansi sha. Ukudluliselwa komsebenzi ngamunye kanye nokubuyekezwa okuphindaphindwayo — okufana nokudlala imishini yokugembula — okuthinta imibhalo, izithombe, amazwi, amavidiyo, umculo namathuluzi okuhlela, kunciphisa kakhulu inzuzo etholakala emsebenzini omningi.
example.solutionTitle: Guqula Insizakalo Yakho Yamavidiyo Ibe Umkhiqizo
example.solutionDescription: Yakha izinqubo zomsebenzi eziphindaphindekayo zezitudiyo ezikhiqiza izindaba zempilo (memoirs) kanye nemikhakha ekhethekile yebhizinisi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukulayishwa kwama-template, ukwenziwa kwamakhophi amazwi, ama-avatar, kanye nokuvunywa kwemibono ngaphambi kokukhiqiza — yenza izinguquko ngokwezidingo zekhasimende ngalinye futhi wandise inzuzo ngokwandisa ivolumu yomsebenzi.
example.win: Qala ibhizinisi lokwenza amavidiyo alondoloza izinkumbulo noma insizakalo ekhethekile yesitudiyo ehlinzekwa ngendlela ephindaphindekayo — hhayi umsebenzi wesikhashana owenziwa kanye kuphela.

paths.label: I-ejensi
paths.outcome: Ukwethulwa kwemibono ngokushesha kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwamakhasimende ngendlela enwebekayo
paths.narrative: Ukuphumelela ekwethulweni kwephrojekthi kusho ukukhombisa umbono — hhayi ukuwuchaza nje — kodwa izigaba zokubona umbono ngaphambi kwesikhathi (pre-viz) kanye nokuguqulela umsebenzi ube ngolimi lendawo (localization) kuvame ukudla inzuzo ngaphambi kokuba kusayinwe inkontileka. I-SceneFlow yenza ukuthi izinhlaka ezithintekayo zibone ngokushesha izinhlaka zokuqala zombono (pre-viz) ezilungele ukuboniswa kumakhasimende, bese yandisa izinga lokulethwa komsebenzi emikhankasweni nasezilulimini ezingaphezu kuka-70 ngaphandle kokuthi kuphinde kwakhiwe kabusha inqubo yokusebenza kuyo yonke i-akhawunti.

example.challengeDescription: Ukunqoba isethulo sephrojekthi (pitch) kuyingxenye nje yomsebenzi. Imisebenzi yamakhasimende ephindaphindekayo idinga ukwenziwa ngokushesha — kodwa ukudluliselana umsebenzi kanye nokuzama ukuphinda ukhiqize ividiyo kaningi usebenzisa amathuluzi ahlukene okudala nokuhlela, kwenza inqubo yonke ihambe kancane.
example.solutionDescription: Shintsha usuke esigabeni sokwethula imibono uye ekukhiqizeni okuqhubekayo, usebenzisa izindlela zokulawula eziqinisekisa ukuphepha komkhiqizo, ukubuyekezwa kwamakhasimende ngaphambi kokukhiqizwa komsebenzi wokugcina, kanye nezindleko zamakhredithi ezibikezelekayo ngomsebenzi ngamunye.
example.win: Feza izinqubo zokwethula amaphrojekthi kanye nomsebenzi wamakhasimende oqhubekayo ngokushesha okukhulu, unciphise ubungozi bokukhiqiza futhi wandise inzuzo.

paths.label: Ukukhiqizwa Kwamafilimu
paths.outcome: Umbhalo we-animatic esebenzisanayo ongayibuka futhi uyihlole ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuqopha
paths.narrative: Ngaphambilini, ukwenza uhlaka olubonakalayo (previz) nokuhlola umbono wezethameli kwakusho amasonto okudala imidwebo yendaba (storyboards), ukuqopha amazwi esikhashana, nokwenza izinqumo ezibizayo ezisekelwe ekuqageleni ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukudutshulwa. I-SceneFlow iguqula umbhalo wakho ube yisethulo esinyakazayo esisebenzisanayo (interactive animatic) kusetshenziswa i-Pre-vis Agent — yithuthukise kusetshenziswa i-Audience Resonance, uyibonise ku-Screening Room, bese ukhipha imali kuphela uma indaba isisebenza kahle futhi yamukelekile.

example.challengeTitle: Ukulungiselela ukubona ngeso lengqondo (pre-visualization) okuhamba kancane ngaphambi kokuba uhlole indaba
example.challengeDescription: Unayo imibhalo yefilimu — kodwa ukufundwa kwayo ngokuhlanganyela, izigaba zokudala imidwebo yezigcawu (storyboards), kanye namathuluzi okubuka kuqala (previz) angahlelekile kahle kubambezela ukwethulwa kweprojekthi kubatshali-zimali, ukuhlolwa kwayo phambi kwezethameli, kanye nezinqumo zokuyivumela ukuthi iqhubeke.
example.solutionTitle: Ukubona Ngeso Lengqondo Kwangaphambili Okusebenzisanayo Okusekelwe Kumbhalo
example.solutionDescription: Layisha umbhalo wakho (ngamafomethi afana ne-MDX, i-FDX, nokunye), uwuthuthukise usebenzisa i-Audience Resonance, bese udala uhlaka olubonakalayo olusebenzisanayo (pre-vis) ukuze uluhlole — ngenkathi i-Production Agents ilungisa imiyalelo futhi ikhiqiza okuqukethwe kuzo zonke izigaba zendaba, ngezinketho zezilimi ezingaphezu kuka-70 kanye nokufakwa kwezilimi eziningi ngokushesha.
example.win: Qinisekisa ukuthi indaba nezethameli kuyahambisana ngaphambi kokuqala ukuthatha izithombe ezisemqoka — usebenzisa i-animatic engabelwana ngayo, hhayi inqubo yokwenza uhlaka lokuqala (previz) ethatha amasonto amaningi.

beatFirstPipeline.title: Inqubo Yokukhiqiza Ividiyo Eqala Ngesigqi
beatFirstPipeline.subtitle: Vumela ngaphambi kokukhiqiza umphumela — hhayi ukuvuselela okufana nomshini wokugembula.
beatFirstPipeline.intro: Akukho ukukhiqiza ngokulinganisa nokuhlola. Uyabuka kuqala bese uvumela ukubukeka kwayo ngaphambi kokuba i-SceneFlow isebenzise amakhredithi kuvidiyo yokugcina.
beatFirstPipeline.description: I-SceneFlow ihlela inqubo yokugunyazwa kokubonakalayo esigabeni ngasinye: i-Pre-vis Agent yokubuyekeza, i-Shot Frames yokumisa ukwakheka kwesithombe, bese kuba yi-F2V esigabeni ngasinye (beat). Uyayilungisa indlela okubukeka ngayo ngaphambi kokuchitha amakhredithi ezintweni ezingahambisani nombono noma emaphutheni okukhiqizwa kokuqukethwe (hallucinations).
steps: Pre-vis Agent — yabelana ngezingxenye ezihlanganisa umsindo nokubonwayo ukuze zibuyekezwe ngemva kokuqondiswa uchwepheshe
Shot Frames — vala ukuqala/ukuphela kokwakheka ngokuhambisana ne-Reference Library
I-F2V ngesigqi — khiqiza ividiyo usebenzisa ozimele (frames) abagunyaziwe, hhayi imiyalelo engacacile.
Uchungechunge oluqhubekayo lwe-EXT — izinyathelo zokwandisa ezingama-secondu angu-7 (ezakhelwe ngaphakathi) zezigaba ezinde zezingxoxo
Production Mixer — ukulungiswa kwesikhathi, umsindo, kanye nokuthunyelwa kokusakazwayo ku-Screening Room
beatFirstPipeline.footerLine: Ukunciphisa ukuphinda kwenziwe imifanekiso yemishini yokugembula — vumela imifanekiso ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imali yokugcina kuvidiyo.

trustSafeguard.title: Izithiyo zokuvikela ezinamazinga amaningi ze-
trustSafeguard.subtitle: Ukuphepha okwakhelwe ngaphakathi yi-Google kukho konke okukhiqizwayo, Izinsizakalo Zobuciko Ezandisiwe ezinezindlela zokulawula lapho kusebenza imikhawulo yenqubomgomo, kanye nokuhlola nokunciphisa ubungozi okwengeziwe kuyo yonke inqubo yakho yokusebenza ku-Studio.

tiers.title: Ezokuphepha ze-Google Zangaphakathi
tiers.description: Yonke inqubo yokukhiqiza izithombe namavidiyo idlula ezihlungini zokuphepha zakwa-Google, lapho amazinga okuhlola elungiselelwe khona izinqubo zomsebenzi wobungcweti bokudala—hhayi izilungiselelo ezijwayelekile ezihloselwe abathengi abavamile.
highlights: I-Vertex Responsible AI mayelana nokukhiqizwa kwe-Veo, i-Imagen, ne-Gemini
Imikhawulo yomonakalo elungiselelwe ukukhiqizwa kokuqukethwe kwefilimu
Izinsiza zakho zobuciko azisetshenziswa ukuqeqesha amamodeli abiwayo.

tiers.title: Izithiyo Zokuvikela Ezandisiwe
tiers.description: Uma indlela eyinhloko ivinjwe yinqubomgomo, i-Extended Creative Services enezinhlelo zokulawula (guardrails) ingakuqedela ukulethwa—kodwa kuphela ngemuva kokuba kubuyekezwe okuqukethwe okwengeziwe ngaphambi kokuba kugcinwe.
highlights: Ukulungiswa okusheshayo kanye nokuzama kabusha indlela emzileni oyinhloko wakwa-Google
Indlela yokubuyela emuva evikelwe enokubuyekezwa okuphoqelekile ngaphambi kokugcinwa
Amazinga okuqukethwe afanayo kuzo zombili izindlela, eyisisekelo neyandisiwe

tiers.title: Ukuqinisekisa kanye Nomlando Wemvelaphi
tiers.description: Kutholakala izindlela ezengeziwe zokuhlola nokuqapha kanye nokunciphisa ubungozi kuyo yonke i-Blueprint, umbhalo (script), ukubuka kuqala (pre-vis), kanye nevidiyo yengxenye—kusetshenziswa uhlelo olufanayo lokunikeza udumo njengakwamanye amathuluzi e-Studio. Ama-clip aphumelelayo athola amarekhodi asayinwe aqinisekisa umsuka wokuqukethwe.
highlights: Izinkomba zokuqinisekisa okuqukethwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa izinsiza eziningi ekukhiqizeni isithombe (rendering)
I-hash yokuqukethwe kanye nemethadatha yomthombo esayinwe ngedijithali kwingxenye yevidiyo
Amarekhodi okuhlola, ukulandelela ukwephulwa kwemithetho, kanye nokubika ukusetshenziswa kabi ukuze kuvikelwe inkundla

trustSafeguard.morNote: I-SceneFlow isebenza ngokwabelana ngemfanelo nozakwethu obhaliswe njengomthengisi (Merchant of Record): lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphepha kwezinga eliphezulu okuvela ku-Google, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela nohlelo lokulandelela imisebenzi okuvela ku-SceneFlow—okunciphisa ubungozi kubadali nakunkundla ngokufanayo.

extendedScenes.title: Ngaphesheya kwevidiyo emfushane yemizuzwana eyisishiyagalombili
extendedScenes.subtitle: Dlulela ngale komkhawulo wesiqeshana esisodwa—qala ngokuvumela ukubukeka kwaso, bese welula isigcawu sakho kancane kancane sibe yizinkulumo zomuntu oyedwa, izincazelo, kanye nezingxenye zengxoxo ezihamba kahle.
extendedScenes.intro: I-SceneFlow ayithembisi ukukhiqiza okuqhubekayo okungenamkhawulo ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ihlela izingcezu zomculo ezinde njengochungechunge oluhleliwe: isiqeshana sokuqala esithatha imizuzwana engafika kwengu-8, kulandelwe izigaba zokwengeza eziqhubekayo zemizuzwana engu-7—kanye nokuvunywa kwengcezu yomculo kuqala ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise amakhredithi akho.

steps.title: Isiqeshana sokuqala sika-8s
steps.description: Ukuguqula uhlaka lube yividiyo noma isithombe sibe yividiyo kusetshenziswa i-Shot Frames egunyaziwe kukhiya ukuhlelwa kwesithombe ngaphambi kokuqala kokunyakaza.

steps.title: Izinyathelo zokwelula ngo-+7s
steps.description: Isinyathelo ngasinye siqhubeka nge-engeli nangokunyakaza okufanayo—okulungele izingxoxo ezingaphazamiseki phakathi nesigqi esithile.

steps.title: Ukugunyazwa okubeka phambili ukudlula okulindelekile
steps.description: Imigqa emide ihlukana ngokuzenzakalelayo ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa kokubukwa kwangaphambili (pre-vis). Uvumela amafreyimu ngaphambi kokuba uchungechunge lukhiqizwe—hhayi inqubo efana nokusebenza komshini wokugembula.

steps.title: Production Mixer qeda
steps.description: Izingxenye ezixhunyiwe zihlanganiswa ekudlalweni kwesigcawu; umsindo ovumelana nesimo ubamba ukulandisa okuqhubeka isikhathi eside kunevidiyo.

stats.label: Isigaba esijwayelekile sengxoxo (imizuzwana engu-8 + isandiso esingu-1)
Isigaba eside senkulumo yomlingiswa oyedwa (imizuzwana engu-8 + izandiso ezi-3)

extendedScenes.footnote: Ukulandelana kokunwetshwa (extension chains) kudinga indlela eyinhloko yokukhiqiza yakwa-Google kanye nezinkomba zevidiyo ezivumelekile phakathi kwezigaba (izinkomba ziphelelwa yisikhathi ngemva kwamahora angaba ngu-48). Isigaba ngasinye se-API sihlala ngaphakathi kwemingcele yesikhathi se-Veo—ubude obuphelele buvela ekuxhumaniseni izigaba, hhayi ekukhiqizeni okuqhubekayo okude okukodwa.

creativeRange.title: Zonke izitayela, zonke izikrini
creativeRange.subtitle: I-Blueprint Room yindawo lapho "i-DNA" yakho yobuciko imiswa khona ngokuqinile—okuhlanganisa isitayela sobuciko, isilinganiso sobukhulu besithombe (aspect ratio), umoya wendaba, kanye nomongo wayo. I-SceneFlow idlulisela lezo zinqumo ohlelweni lokuqala lwendaba (treatment), ku-Audience Resonance, kanye nasekudalweni kombhalo (script), ukuze imiyalelo yesigcawu ihambisane nohlaka nokubukeka okufunayo kusukela ekuqaleni—hhayi njengezilungiselelo zokugcina ngesikhathi sokukhipha umsebenzi.

pillars.title: Ukuma Kulandela Umsebenzi (kanye noHlaka)
pillars.description: Usayizi wesikrini unquma indlela yokuxoxa indaba ngokubonakalayo. Ifomethi emile engu-9:16 idinga ukuhlelwa kwendawo okuminyene, izindlela zokuheha izibukeli ezisheshayo, kanye nokuqondisa okugxile kakhulu ekuthathweni kwezithombe ezisondele kakhulu (close-ups)—okuhluke kakhulu endleleni yokuhlela izigcawu zesikrini esibanzi esingu-16:9. Khiya isilinganiso sobukhulu besithombe (aspect ratio) ku-Blueprint ukuze uhlelo lokubhala umbhalo wesiqondiso (script) lukwazi ukubhala imiyalelo yezigcawu ehambisana nobungako besikrini.

pillars.title: Isitayela sobuciko sinquma indlela yokubhala.
pillars.description: Ama-anime ohlobo lwe-Noir kanye nemikhiqizo ye-Pixar ye-3D kudinga izingxoxo, isimo, kanye nesivinini sokuhamba kwendaba okuhlukene. Khetha isitayela osifunayo ku-Blueprint, bese i-LLM ifaka lowo moya noma isitayela ngqo ekwakhekeni kombhalo (i-DNA yawo)—hhayi njengesihlungi esifakwa ngemuva kokuba umbhalo usuqediwe.

creativeRange.blueprintTagline: Ithoni kanye nendaba eyinhloko kuqedela uhlelo—i-Blueprint ingubuchopho; ukukhiqiza kungumsipha.

artStyles.subsectionIntro: Ukubukeka kwakho akuyona nje indlela yokuhlela isithombe esivele ikhona—kuwumoya wombhalo wakho. Misa isitayela sobuciko ku-Blueprint, bese zonke izigaba zilandela lowo mklamo.
artStyles.footnote: Kuqinisekiswe isisekelo sokubukwayo se-Blueprint—okwaqhubeka kulo lonke uhlelo kusukela kumbhalo, ukubuka kuqala (pre-vis), kuya ekukhiqizweni kokugcina (final render).

items.name: Ifilimu enabadlali bangempela
items.description: Ukukhanya okufana nokwangempela, okufana nokwamafilimu
items.tagline: Umsebenzi wobuciko obukhulu nobunemininingwane eminingi obubonisa iqiniso
items.marketingBody: Isitayela esibukeka njengempilo yangempela (photorealism) siletha lokho okuthandwa yizithameli eziningi futhi okulindelekile ezinhlelweni ze-TV ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nakuma-documentary. Qinisekisa ukuthi abalingiswa nokukhanya kubukeka kungokoqobo kuzo zonke izigaba zendaba ezilandelanayo, ukuze imidlalo yochungechunge kanye nochungechunge lwama-documentary kugcine ukugeleza kwemizwa okungaguquki kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni.

Lokhu kulungele kakhulu uchungechunge lwezithombe ezinyakazayo (animation), izinhlelo ezinde zemindeni, kanye nokuxoxwa kwezindaba okugqamisa uhlobo lomkhiqizo, lapho kubaluleke khona ukuthi abalingiswa bahlale bengaguquki kuzo zonke izigaba zendaba.

outputFormats.subsectionIntro: Ukukhetha indlela yokubeka isithombe (framing) kuyingxenye yokulandisa indaba, hhayi nje into okumele uyikhethe lapho ukhipha umsebenzi. I-Blueprint inquma isilinganiso sobukhulu besithombe (aspect ratio) ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe imiyalelo yokuqala yesigcawu.
outputFormats.resolutionFootnote: Kukhethwe ku-Blueprint; umbhalo kanye nesiqondiso sesigcawu kusekelwe kulolu hlaka. Khipha ngekhwalithi engu-720p noma 1080p lapho iphrojekthi yakho ikusekela khona lokho.

items.label: Isikrini esibanzi esingu-16:9
items.description: Ku-YouTube eyinhloko, ku-TV exhunywe ku-inthanethi, nakuchungechunge lweziqephu—i-Blueprint ibhala imiyalelo yezigcawu zesikrini esibanzi kanye nokuhlelwa kokuma kwabalingisi ukuze kwakhiwe isimo esifana nesefilimu.

items.label: 9:16 Omi mpo
items.description: Ezinhlelweni zedrama ezilandelanayo ezibukwa zime mpo kanye nochungechunge olwenzelwe amafoni—i-Blueprint ibhala izinhlelo zokuma kwabalingisi (blocking) ezifanele ukubukwa zime mpo, isivinini esisheshayo nesigxilile, kanye nokuqondisa okugxile ekuboniseni ubuso babalingisi eduze, okuyizinto ezilindelwe ngabantu abathanda ukuzibukela zilandelana ngokushesha (binge-watchers).

items.label: Isikwele esingu-1:1
items.description: Iziqeshana zeziqephu ezimise okwesikwele, amaqoqo ezingxoxo, kanye nezikhathi ezibalulekile ezikhethwe ochungechungeni olude — lokhu kuyingxenye eyodwa yemitapo yeziqephu eyenzelwe ngqo izinkundla zokuxhumana.

items.label: 4:3 Yakudala
items.description: Amamojuli okuqeqesha, amaqoqo amafilimu okubhala ngamaqiniso, kanye nezinhlaka ezifanele izethulo, lapho izethameli zakho zilindele isimo esijwayelekile sokwethulwa kokuqukethwe okude.

sceneflowWay.title: Indlela ye-SceneFlow
sceneflowWay.tagline: Isitudiyo esisodwa. Ukuzenzakalela okuqondiswayo — noma ukukhiqiza okukhulu kakhulu uma usuwazi kakade uhlelo lobuchwepheshe obusetshenziswayo.

toolStack.comparisonCaption: Isitudiyo esisodwa sithatha indawo yamathuluzi okukhiqiza ahlukene, ukuphinda kukhiqizwe amavidiyo ngendlela engahleliwe (njengomshini wokugembula), kanye nokuhlanganisa ukuhlela okwenziwa ngesandla.
toolStack.comparisonImageAlt: Izindleko zokukhiqiza ngendlela evamile uma kuqhathaniswa nesitudiyo esisebenza ngokuzenzakalela — kusukela emcabangweni kuya kuvidiyo elungele ukushicilelwa ngokushesha okukhulu
toolStack.costNote: Izindleko ze-AI ziyafana, kodwa isikhathi esichithwa ngize sinciphile. Ukhokhela amamodeli noma ngabe kanjani — kungaba ngamakhredithi e-SceneFlow, i-akhawunti yakho yomhlinzeki, noma nge-BYOK. I-SceneFlow iqeda izindleko ezengeziwe zokuhlanganisa okuqukethwe ngokukopisha nokunamathisela, okukuvumela ukuthi ukhiqize futhi ukhiphe amavidiyo amaningi ngesabelomali esifanayo.
toolStack.proofLine: Kuqinisekiswe ohambweni lokuhlola indlu efakwe ohlwini: inqubo ephelele eyenziwa ngesandla ithatha amahora angaphezu kwama-4 → umphumela ofanayo usebenzisa i-SceneFlow uthatha isikhathi esingaphansi kwehora.

I-SceneFlow yona ifunda zonke izithombe ngokusekelwe ezinkomba ezifanayo ezimisiwe, ngakho-ke isigcawu esingu-100 siyaqhubeka nokuhambisana nesigcawu soku-1.

howItWorks.title: Kusukela emcabangweni kuya kuvidiyo esilungele ukushicilelwa
howItWorks.subtitle: Uchungechunge aluphoqelekile. Indlela eyinhloko ithi Blueprint Room → Production Stage → Screening Room — okuhlanganisa i-pre-vis, i-animatic, ividiyo yesigcawu, kanye ne-master MP4 phakathi naleso sikhathi.

phases.subtitle: Ukuqhubeka kwendaba ezingxenyeni eziningi
phases.description: Chaza umhlaba wakho kanye bese udala izindaba ezihambisanayo ezihlanganisa iziqephu eziningi. Ukusebenzisa i-Reference Library ngokuhlanganyela kuqinisekisa ukuthi abalingiswa nesimo sendaba kuhlala kuhambisana kuso sonke isizini.
keySteps: Chaza umhlaba wendaba — abalingiswa, isimo sendaba, kanye nohlelo olukhulu lwesizini.
Khiqiza ngokuzenzakalelayo uhlaka lweziqephu zayo yonke isizini
Vumelanisa ne-Blueprint Room kanye ne-Production Stage esiqeshini ngasinye.
keyFeatures: Chaza umhlaba wakho kanye kuphela — abalingiswa, isimo, kanye nohlelo lwendaba lwesizini.
Izinhlaka zeziqephu ezihleleke kahle — ezikhiqizwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuso sonke isizini
Ukulandelela ukuqhubeka — ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziqephu zezinkathi eziningi ziyahambisana
Ukuvumelanisa uchungechunge neziqephu — ku-Blueprint Room naku-Production Stage

phases.description: Guqula imiqondo ibe yizinhlaka ezihleliwe ezihlanganisa isifinyezo sendaba (logline), izigaba ezibalulekile (beats), abalingiswa, kanye nesimo sendaba (tone). Sebenzisa i-Audience Resonance futhi usebenzisane nabanye ngaphambi kokuqala inqubo enzima yokukhiqiza isithombe sokugcina (rendering).

Ukusuka emcabangweni kuya esakhiweni ngemizuzu — isifinyezo sendaba, izigaba ezibalulekile, abalingiswa, kanye nomoya wendaba

Izixhumanisi zokwabelana zabahlanganyeli — ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono ukuze kwenziwe ukulungisa okuqondisiwe

phases.subtitle: Isiqondiso ngokusebenzisa imifudlana
phases.description: Ukuqondisa, umbhalo, umculo, izinkomba, kanye nezithombe ezimile kuthuthukisa umbhalo kusetshenziswa i-Audience Resonance kanye nokubuyekezwa kwe-Pre-Vis. Ama-clip, i-mixer, kanye nama-stream kukhiqiza ividiyo yawo wonke umfanekiso (shot). I-Screening Room iphethe ukubuka kuqala, ukuhlanganisa, kanye nokushicilela.

Dala uhlelo lokuhlola bese wabelana ngesixhumanisi

Ukuhlolwa okwabelwanayo — izixhumanisi ezinezikolo kanye nempendulo ehleliwe
Ingcweti ye-YouTube, ukukhiqizwa kwamavidiyo amafushane, kanye namaphakethe okusabalalisa

simpleWalkthrough.title: Kusukela emcabangweni kuya kuvidiyo esilungele ukushicilelwa
simpleWalkthrough.subtitle: Qala ngombono noma umbhalo, uthuthukise usebenzisa i-Blueprint ne-Audience Resonance, ubone ngeso lengqondo usebenzisa i-Pre-Vis, uqophe ividiyo yesigcawu, uhlole ku-Screening Room, bese ushicilela — konke lokhu kwenziwa esitudiyo esisodwa.
simpleWalkthrough.tagline: Isinyathelo ngasinye senziwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngobuchwepheshe obuphezulu. Isinyathelo ngasinye sikunikeza amandla aphelele okulawula.

steps.stepLabel: Qala ngomqondo wakho noma umbhalo okhona kakade.
steps.shortDescription: Qala ngomqondo obhalwe ngolimi olujwayelekile noma ufake umbhalo wakho wefilimu — Fountain, Final Draft, noma unamathisele umbhalo wakho.
steps.detailedDescription: I-SceneFlow yamukela imibono ngolimi olulula noma ngefomethi yombhalo wesikrini ehleliwe. Ubuchwepheshe be-AI busiza ekwandiseni imibono ukuze ibe yizinhlaka zendaba (treatments), futhi bungangenisa imibhalo yesikrini esivele ikhona ukuze ungaphinde uqale phansi ekhasini elingenalutho.
steps.screenshotSlot: Faka isithombe-skrini: Ibhokisi lengxoxo lokufaka umqondo wephrojekthi entsha noma lokungenisa umbhalo (script)

steps.stepLabel: Thuthukisa umqondo wakho usebenzisa i-Blueprint Room
steps.shortDescription: Guqula imibono ibe uhlaka oluhleliwe — okuhlanganisa isifinyezo esikhulu (logline), izigaba ezibalulekile zendaba (beats), abalingiswa, kanye nesimo semizwa — ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi onzima wokukhiqiza isithombe sokugcina (rendering).
steps.detailedDescription: I-Blueprint yakha uhlaka oluphelele lwendaba ngokuzenzakalelayo. Thuthukisa ukuthuthuka kwabalingiswa, izigaba ezibalulekile zendaba, kanye nesimo sendaba usebenzisa iziphakamiso ezihlakaniphile. Izixhumanisi zokwabelana zivumela abathintekayo ukuthi babuyekeze okuqukethwe ngaphambi kwesigaba se-Production Stage.

steps.stepLabel: Thuthukisa umbhalo wakho usebenzisa i-Audience Resonance
steps.shortDescription: Linganisela umbhalo wakho ngokuthi ufaneleka kangakanani ezithamelini oziqondisile, bese usebenzisa izincomo zesigcawu ngasinye ngokulungisa ngokushesha ngokuchofoza kanye.
steps.detailedDescription: I-Audience Resonance (AR) ihlaziya umbhalo wakho ngokujulile ngokubheka izethameli ozichazile. Thola amaphuzu ezinga lesigaba, izincomo ezingasetshenziswa, kanye ne-Guided Edits — sebenzisa izinguquko ngokuzenzakalelayo esigabeni ngasinye noma wenze izinguquko ezinkulu embhalweni wonke usebenzisa ibhokisi lezingxoxo le-AR.

steps.stepLabel: Bona ngeso lengqondo futhi uhlole ngokusebenzisa ukubona ngeso lengqondo kusengaphambili
steps.shortDescription: Khiqiza umsindo wengxoxo kanye nezithombe ezibonisa ukulandelana kwezigcawu (shot frames) ngokwezigcawu. Yabelana ngama-animatic ukuze uthole imvume ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imali yokugcina kwividiyo.
steps.detailedDescription: I-Pre-Vis Studio ikhiqiza izinkomba, umsindo, kanye nezithombe ezibonisa ukulandelana kwezenzo (shot frames) esigabeni ngasinye — okuyizigaba zokuhlola ezinciphisa isidingo sokuphinda umsebenzi obiza imali eningi uma kwenzeka kuba noshintsho kubalingiswa noma esimweni somoya wendaba. Yabelana ngesixhumanisi sokubuka ukuze nisebenzisane; i-animatic ephelele ingaba umkhiqizo wokugcina wamaphrojekthi amaningi.

steps.shortDescription: Dala isithombe ngasinye ku-Clips, hlanganisa umsindo ku-Mixer, bese ukhipha izinhlobo zezilimi ku-Streams.
steps.detailedDescription: Ama-clip akhiqiza ividiyo yesigaba ngasinye sokuqoshwa kusetshenziswa izithombe ezimile ezigunyaziwe. I-Mixer inquma isikhathi, izimpawu zokuhlonza (watermarks), kanye nomsindo. Ama-stream yizinhlobo zezilimi ezahlukene zaleso sigcawu.
subPoints: Ama-clip — ividiyo eqoshiwe esuselwe ezithombeni ezivunyiwe
Isihlanganisi — uphawu lwamanzi, umbhalo obekwe phezu kwesithombe, kanye nesikhathi somsindo ngesigcawu ngasinye
Izifudlana — izinguqulo zezilimi zesehlakalo, ezilungele i-Screening Room

steps.stepLabel: Hlola uhlelo lwakho olusebenzayo usebenzisa i-Screening Room
steps.shortDescription: Buka kuqala amavidiyo ezigcawu ngokulandelana kwawo, hlanganisa ifayela eliyinhloko le-MP4, bese uhlela ukubukiswa okungabiwa nabanye kanye nokuqoqa imibono ehlelekile.
steps.detailedDescription: I-Screening Room ilingisa isipiliyoni somsebenzisi (UX) sesidlali se-Pre-Vis kodwa idlala imifudlana yezigcawu eseyenziwe (rendered). Khetha i-Animatic noma i-Video yesigcawu ngasinye, hlanganisa inguqulo eyinhloko, wabelane ngezixhumanisi zokubuyekeza, bese uhlela imibono enezikhathi ngaphambi kokushicilela.

steps.shortDescription: Sabalalisa inguqulo yakho yokugcina ku-YouTube, khipha iziqeshana ezimfushane, futhi ulandelele imininingwane mayelana nezithameli usuka endaweni eyodwa yokugcina umsebenzi.
steps.detailedDescription: Ukusuka ku-Screening Room, sebenzisa ithuluzi eliqondisa inqubo yokushicilela ku-YouTube, udale amafayela amafushane ezinkundla zokuxhumana, futhi ulande amaphakethe okusabalalisa. Imininingwane yokuhlaziya kanye nemibono yabahloli kuhlala endaweni eyodwa — akukho sidingo sokudlulisela umsebenzi kwamanye amathuluzi ahlukene.

productionShowcase.title: Buka uhlelo oluphelele lokugeleza komsebenzi
productionShowcase.subtitle: Isibonelo ngasinye siqala ngesiqeshana esifushane sokubuka kuqala (trailer). Uhlobo oluphelele lomsebenzi — okuyimikhiqizo ephelele kusukela esigabeni sokuhlela nokuklama (blueprint) kuya esigabeni sokubona ngeso lengqondo kusengaphambili (pre-vis) kuze kufike enguqulweni yokugcina — ludlalwa egumbini lokubukela.
productionShowcase.screeningRoomInstruction: Hlola lo msebenzi ngendlela umhloli angawuhlola ngayo — isigaba ngasinye ngokulandelana kwaso. Qala nge-Series, bese kuba yi-Blueprint, kulandele umbhalo (script) ku-AR Analysis, bese uqeda nge-Screening.
productionShowcase.explorerHandoff: Lezi zixhumanisi zingumsebenzi oqediwe. I-Explorer yindawo lapho uzakhela khona owakho.
productionShowcase.languagesBanner: Izibonelo zomphakathi zitholakala ngezilimi ezine: isiNgisi, iSpanishi, isiShayina kanye nesi-Arabhu.
productionShowcase.videoLanguagePrompt: Bukela ngesiNgisi, iSpanish, isiShayina, noma isi-Arabhu.

cards.title: Idrama yefilimu egcwele. Akukho kushintsha kwesimo sabalingiswa.
cards.subtitle: Gcina ukubukeka kobuso babalingiswa, izingubo, kanye nezindawo kusukela esigcawini soku-1 kuya kwesingu-100. Vakashela igumbi lokubukela ukuze ubone i-Pre-Vis, ividiyo enyakazayo yesigcawu ngasinye, kanye nenguqulo yokugcina ye-ProRes 4K — bese ushintsha ulimi ukuze uzwe inguqulo egcwele enamazwi aqoshiwe (dub).

solutionPillars.title: Ukungaguquguquki Kokubonakalayo kanye Nezici Zomlingiswa
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: Ukushintsha Kancane Kancane Kwesimo Somlingiswa kanye Nezindawo Zokudlala Ezingazinzile.
solutionPillars.friction: Amamodeli akhiqizayo aqala kabusha ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho kuthathwa isithombe noma ividiyo — okwenza ubuso babalingiswa, izingubo zabo, kanye nokukhanya kushintshe ngokuqhubekayo lapho kushintshwa izigcawu.
solutionPillars.solution: Chaza imininingwane eyisisekelo yezinhlamvu, izindawo, kanye nezitayela ezibonakalayo kusenesikhathi ku-Blueprint Room. I-SceneFlow iqinisekisa ukuthi isitayela esibonakalayo sihlala singaguquki kuzo zonke izigaba zokukhiqizwa kwesithombe (render), ukuze kugcinwe umuzwa wokucwila ngokuphelele endabeni.

solutionPillars.title: Isivinini Sokulandisa Nokulawulwa Kwezigcawu
solutionPillars.friction: Ukwakha ifilimu kusetshenziswa imiyalelo emifushane engahlangene kuholela ekuhambeni kwefilimu okungahambi kahle, imizwa engavezwanga kahle, kanye nomsebenzi ongapheli wokuhlela izingxenye zefilimu ngesandla.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Ukudweba Uhlaka Lwendaba Ngokugxila Ezigabeni Ezibalulekile
solutionPillars.solution: Qondisa izinga lesigcawu, hhayi izinga lomyalo wombhalo. Hlela izigaba ezibalulekile zedrama, ukunyakaza kwekhamera, kanye nokwakheka kwendaba ngendlela ebonakalayo ngaphambi kokukhiqiza ngisho nohlaka olulodwa lwevidiyo.

solutionPillars.title: Ukuvumelanisa Ingxoxo Nomsindo
solutionPillars.friction: Ukungahambisani kokunyakaza kwezindebe nomsindo, ukunyakaza komlomo okungahambisani kahle nobuso, kanye nomsindo ongahambisani nesithombe, kuphazamisa ngokushesha ukugxila kwababukeli emdlalweni.
solutionPillars.solution: Ukusebenza kwezwi okugcwele amandla nokuvumelana okunembile kokunyakaza kwezindebe nokukhuluma kufakwe ngqo ohlelweni lokukhiqizwa kwevidiyo — okuletha izingxoxo ezizwakala zingokoqobo ngaphandle kwesidingo sezigaba ezengeziwe zokulungisa ividiyo ngemuva kokuyiqopha.

solutionPillars.title: Izithiyo Ekuhambeni Komsebenzi Nokukhathala Ngenxa Yokuphinda Kwenziwe
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: Isiphithiphithi Sezinsiza kanye Nokukhetha Kabusha Okungapheli.
solutionPillars.friction: Ukukhiqiza ifilimu emfushane kuvame ukusho ukubhekana namafayela evidiyo angaphezu kuka-200 angakacutshungulwa, ukukhulisa ikhwalithi yesithombe ngesandla, kanye nokuchitha imizamo eminingi yokukhiqiza engaphumelelanga.
solutionPillars.solution: Kusukela emcabangweni kuya kufayela lokugcina le-MP4, konke kwenziwa enkundleni eyodwa ehlangene. I-Blueprint Room iphethe ukuhlelwa kwendaba, i-Production Stage ilawula ukuqondisa umsebenzi (Direction) ngokusebenzisa ama-Stream, kanti i-Screening Room ikhiqiza umphumela wokugcina.

cards.title: Uchungechunge lwezithombe ezinyakazayo lwesizini ephelele olunezindlela eziningi zobuciko, kodwa olusebenzisa indlela eyodwa engaguquki yobuciko.
cards.subtitle: Qinisekisa ukuthi isitayela esithi "flat-cel," umndeni wakwaHart, kanye nedolobha laseMillwick kuhlala kungaguquki kusukela esiqeshini sokuqala kuya kwesokugcina. Qondisa amahlaya isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, bese ubuyekeza isiqephu egumbini lokubukela (screening room).

solutionPillars.title: Ukungaguquguquki kwesitayela
solutionPillars.friction: Izitayela zama-cartoon nama-anime zihlale zishintsha phakathi kwama-shot, lapho imigqa iguquguquka khona, imibala iphazamiseka, futhi abalingiswa baphenduke babe yinto engajwayelekile, exakile, nebukeka njengento yangempela kodwa engahlelekile.
solutionPillars.solution: Londoloza isitayela sakho sobuciko kusukela kuhlaka lokuqala. Lesi sici sigcina ukwakheka kwabalingiswa, ubukhulu bemigqa, kanye nezindlela zokufaka imithunzi kungaguquki kuso sonke isiqephu, ukuze abalingiswa bakho bahlale beyibo ngendlela eyingqayizivele.

solutionPillars.title: Izithombe Ezinyakazayo Nezimiso Zokusebenza Kwemizimba Okwedlulele
solutionPillars.friction: Izinhlelo ezikhiqiza okuqukethwe (generative models) zibhekana nobunzima uma kuziwa kumahlaya asheshayo omzimba, ukusabela okungazelelwe (njengokubheka kabili), kanye nokunyakaza okuguquguqukayo okufana nokwopopayi, okwenza amahlaya anamandla aphenduke izithombe ezonakele ezibukeka sengathi ziyancibilika.
solutionPillars.solution: Lawula ukunyakaza okunamandla kwezinhlamvu kanye nokuma okukhombisa imizwa ngaphandle kokulimaza ukwakheka kwazo. Qondisa amahlaya omzimba anomthelela, ukushintsha okungazelelwe kwesithombe, kanye nokubonakaliswa kwemizwa okukhulu ngenkathi unokulawula okuphelele kokunyakaza.

solutionPillars.title: Isikhathi Nesigqi Sokuhlekisa
solutionPillars.friction: Amahlaya atholakala ezikhatshana zokuthula kanye nasekushintsheni kwesigqi ngokuzumayo. Imijikelezo ejwayelekile yemizuzwana emihlanu eyenziwa ngobuchwepheshe iphoqa isigqi esingahambi kahle, okonakalisa indlela yokwethula ihlaya.
solutionPillars.solution: Lawula isivinini sesigcawu kuze kufike ezingeni lozimele (frame). Lungisa ukuma okuletha umuzwa, isikhathi esiphakathi kokwakha isimo kanye nomzuzu ohlekisayo noma omangalisayo (punchline), kanye nezithombe ezisheshayo zokuphendula, konke lokhu ukwenze ngqo ohlwini lwesikhathi oluhlelwe ngokwesigqi ngaphambi kokukhiqizwa kokugcina kwevidiyo.

solutionPillars.title: Ingxoxo Enamandla Nokuvumelaniswa Kwamazwi
solutionPillars.friction: Izingxoxo ezijwayelekile ezikhiqizwa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) zizwakala zingenampilo futhi zingenamoya wemvelo, okubulala amandla adingekayo ezingxoxweni ezisheshayo nezijabulisayo zemidlalo yamahlaya yasethelevishini.
solutionPillars.solution: Qondanisa ngqo indlela yokukhuluma nokubonakaliswa kwemizwa ebusweni okugcwele amandla. Izingxoxo, ukunyakaza komlomo okukhombisa imizwa, kanye nemisindo yamahlaya kuhambisana kahle kakhulu ukuze kutholakale umphumela wamahlaya omuhle kakhulu.

cards.title: Amafilimu Emibhalo Abalinganiso Abade. Ukuvela Kobuhlakani.
cards.subtitle: Landela ukukhula kobuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) kanye nobuhlakani obudlulele (superintelligence) emazwenikazi ahlukene. Isahluko ngasinye sibonakala sengathi simele unyaka waso — akukho zinto zesimanje ezinjini zokucwaninga zakuqala, futhi akukho zimo zango-1950 ezikhathini zamanje.

solutionPillars.title: Ukunemba Kokubukeka Okuhambisana Nesikhathi Esithile
solutionPillars.friction: Amamodeli ajwayelekile okukhiqiza okuqukethwe avame ukufaka izinto zesimanje, izikrini zama-smartphone, noma izingubo ezingahambisani nesikhathi esithile, ezithombeni noma kumavidiyo aphinde enze kabusha izigcawu zomlando.
solutionPillars.solution: Misa imingcele eqondile yesikhathi — kusukela ekubukekeni kwefilimu kweminyaka yawo-1920 kuya ezinhlotsheni zezindwangu zezingubo zekhulu le-18 — ukuze isigcawu ngasinye esenziweyo sihlale sithembekile emlandweni.

solutionPillars.title: Uhlelo Lokuphatha Izithombe Zokugcina kanye ne-B-Roll
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: Ukuntuleka kokuhlukahlukana kokubonwayo ezinkulumweni ezinde ezingemuva
solutionPillars.friction: Ukuhlanganisa ukulandisa okude nezithombe ezimile kuholela ekutheni izibukeli ziyeke ukubuka ngokushesha ngenkathi kuhlaziywa izindaba ngokujulile.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Uhlelo Lokukhiqiza Izithombe Ezisekelayo (B-Roll) Olusekelwe Kumbhalo
solutionPillars.solution: Njengoba umxoxi wakho exoxa ngamaqiniso omlando, i-SceneFlow ikhiqiza ngokuzenzakalelayo izigcawu ezilingisa okwenzeka ngendlela yamafilimu, imibhalo eboniswa phezu kwesithombe, kanye nezithombe ezifakiwe ezifana nalezo zokugcinwa kwamarekhodi—konke lokhu kuhambisana ngqo nombhalo walokho okukhulunywayo.

solutionPillars.title: Ubuqiniso bezingxoxo nokubonisa umuntu ekhuluma ngqo ekhamereni
solutionPillars.friction: Izazi zomlando, abaphenyi, noma oFakazi abakhiqizwe ngobuchwepheshe bavame ukubukeka bengewona amaqiniso, benokunyakaza kwesilevu okungajwayelekile kanye nokubhekana ngamehlo okungabonakali kwemvelo.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Amaphrofayili Ochwepheshe Akhiyiwe kanye Nokuvumelaniswa Kwezwi
solutionPillars.solution: Londoloza izimo zezingxoxo ezibukeka zingokoqobo futhi ezinokwethenjelwa, ezihlanganisa ukubonakala kwemizwa okuncane okungokwemvelo, ukuvumelana okunembile kokunyakaza kwezindebe nenkulumo, kanye nobunjalo obungaguquki bochwepheshe kulo lonke uchungechunge lweziqephu eziningi.

solutionPillars.title: Isivinini Sokuhamba Kweziqephu kanye Nokulandelana Okungaphazamiseki Kwendaba
solutionPillars.friction: Ukulinganisa umsindo womlandisi, izigcawu eziphindaphinda okwenzeka, ukudalulwa kobufakazi, kanye nokumiswa okwakha ukushuba kulo lonke uhlelo oluthatha imizuzu engama-40, kuvame ukuthatha amasonto amaningi kusetshenziswa izinhlelo zokuhlela ividiyo (NLEs) ezijwayelekile.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Inqubo Yokukhiqizwa Kwama-Documentary Ebeka Izigaba Zendaba Phambili
solutionPillars.solution: Hlela ukungezwani okushubisayo, ukumiswa kwesikhashana okwakha ukulindela, kanye nokudalulwa kobufakazi ngendlela ebonakalayo ngaphakathi kwe-Blueprint Room, ukuze ukhiqize ifayela eliyinhloko eliqedelwe ngokuphelele ngesinyathelo esisodwa esingenaziphazamiso.

cards.title: Uchungechunge Lokuqeqesha Olunezinhlaka Eziningi Olulungele Uhlelo Lokufunda. Umpheki Oyedwa Ovalelwe.
cards.subtitle: Umpheki oyedwa, ikhishi elilodwa, izidlo ezinhlanu. Ubuso, ijazi, kanye namathayela kuhlala kungashintshi kusukela esobhlweni kuya kudessert yokugcina.

solutionPillars.title: Ukungaguquguquki kukaMfundisi kanye neSimo
solutionPillars.friction: Aziqeshana zevidiyo ezikhiqizwa ngobuchwepheshe zishintsha ubuso bomfundisi, izingubo zakhe, kanye negumbi lokufundela phakathi kwezifundo, okwenza inkambo ibonakale njengeqoqo lamavidiyo angahlobene.
solutionPillars.solution: Chaza umfundisi, isethi, kanye nohlelo lokubonwayo kanye kuphela ku-Blueprint Room. I-SceneFlow igcina lowo mbono uqinile kuwo wonke amamojuli.

solutionPillars.title: Isivinini Sokufundisa Uhlelo Lokufunda
solutionPillars.friction: Ukuguqula uhlelo lokufunda lube yimiyalelo engahlangene kuholela ekulahlekelweni ukulandelana kwesifundo, isibonelo esixazululiwe, kanye nekhefu ngaphambi kokuhlolwa okufushane.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Ukudwetshwa Kohlelo Lokulandisa Okubeka Amamojuli Phambili.
solutionPillars.solution: Lawula isigaba ngasinye njengochungechunge lwezigaba zokufundisa — ukulungiselela, ukukhombisa, kanye nokuhlola — ngaphambi kokuba kwakhiwe isithombe sokugcina.

solutionPillars.title: Ukulandisa nokufundisa okubonakala esikrinini
solutionPillars.friction: Ukulandisa, imibhalo echazayo, kanye nemidwebo kuyahlukana, ngakho abafundi bezwa ngesinyathelo esisodwa kanti isithombe sikhombisa esinye.
solutionPillars.solution: Izwi, imibhalo, kanye nokufundisa okubonakala esikrinini kuhambisana kahle, ukuze incazelo ngayinye ihambisane nesithombe noma ividiyo eyiqinisekisayo.

solutionPillars.title: Umhlangano Wesifundo
solutionPillars.friction: Ukuhlanganisa izigaba zezifundo, ukuphinda kuqoshwe, kanye nezinguqulo ezilungiselelwe izindawo ezithile ngaphakathi kohlelo lwesikhathi olujwayelekile, kwenza ukubuyekezwa kohlelo lokufunda kuphenduke ukubambezeleka ekukhiqizeni.
solutionPillars.solution: I-Blueprint, i-Audience Resonance, kanye ne-Screening Room ziqhuba imojuli kusukela ohlakeni lokuqala kuya ku-Pre-Vis, ukuhlelwa kokuqala (rough cut), izigcawu, kanye nesifundo esiphelele.

platformWalkthrough.title: Incazelo enemininingwane yokusetshenziswa kwenkundla
platformWalkthrough.subtitle: Nweba ukuze ubuke amavidiyo aqondisayo mayelana nokuhlelwa kochungechunge, ukugcinwa kokuvumelana kwezinkomba, ukujula kokukhiqizwa, i-Screening Room, kanye nokwethenjwa nokuphepha — okuhloselwe abahloli bezobuchwepheshe kanye nalabo abafuna ukuhlaziya ngokujulile.
platformWalkthrough.subheading: Ukubheka ngaphakathi — amavidiyo aqondisayo abahloli bezobuchwepheshe
platformWalkthrough.chapterHint: Nweba ukuze uhlanganise ukuhlelwa kochungechunge, ukuqhubeka kokubhekisela emuva, ukujula kokukhiqiza, kanye nokwethenjwa nokuphepha.

chapters.label: Qala lapha — uhlelo, ukuqhubeka, kanye nokufaneleka kubalaleli
Khiqiza futhi ushicilele — Ama-clip ku-Screening Room

beatFirst.title: Inqubo Yokukhiqiza Ividiyo Eqala Ngesigqi
beatFirst.description: Vumela izigaba ze-pre-vis kanye ne-Shot Frames ngaphambi kwesigaba se-F2V — lokhu kunciphisa ukwenziwa kabusha okungenanjongo okubangelwa ukulahleka kombono noma amaphutha okubukwayo. Indlela eyodwa ehlelekile kusukela ekubuyekezweni kuya esiqeshini sokugcina.
keyFeatures: I-Pre-vis Agent ilinde ukubuyekezwa — yabelana ngezigaba (beats) ngaphambi kokwenza umsebenzi wokugcina wokuhlela isithombe/ividiyo (heavy render).
Ukulungiswa kokwakheka kohlaka — ukuqhubeka
I-F2V ngesigqi ngasinye — khiqiza ividiyo kusuka kuzinhlaka ezivunyiwe
Uchungechunge oluqhubekayo lwe-EXT — izinyathelo ze-native +7s zezingxoxo ezinde ngaphakathi kwesigqi
Isikhathi sokuxuba kanye nemifudlana — vula i-Screening Room ukuze uhlanganise futhi ushicilele

screeningRoom.title: Igama Legumbi Lokuhlola le-SFAI
screeningRoom.description: Buka kuqala amavidiyo ezigcawu, hlanganisa inguqulo yokugcina, bese ushicilela — konke lokhu kwenziwa ngaphakathi esigabeni sokukhiqiza (Production). Thumela izixhumanisi eziyimfihlo kwababambe iqhaza ukuze bathumele imibono ehlelekile, kanye nokukhetha ukuthola imininingwane ehlaziya indlela abasebenzisana ngayo nokuqukethwe.
keyFeatures: Ukubuka kuqala kwevidiyo yesigcawu — dlala imifudlana ekhiqiziwe ngokulandelana
Ukuhlanganiswa kokugcina — khetha i-Animatic noma ividiyo yesigcawu ngasinye bese ukhiqiza ifayela elilodwa le-MP4.
Ukuhlolwa okungabiwa nabanye — izixhumanisi eziphephile ezihlanganisa ukunikezwa amaphuzu kanye nokuhlelwa kwempendulo
Shicilela — I-wizard ye-YouTube, ukukhiqizwa kwamavidiyo amafushane, kanye namaphakethe okusabalalisa
screeningRoom.screenshotSlot: Faka isithombe-skrini: Iphaneli yokuhlaziya kanye nempendulo yomhloli ye-Screening Room
screeningRoom.videoSlot: Faka isiqeshana esithatha imizuzwana engu-30: Ukubamba umhlangano wokubuyekeza kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane mayelana nokubamba iqhaza

items.title: Uhluzi lweplathifomu
items.description: Isitudiyo esisodwa esenza yonke into, kusukela emcabangweni kuya kuvidiyo esilungele ukushicilelwa. Kusetshenziswa inqubo efanayo yokuqeqesha, ama-podcast, izindaba, kanye nochungechunge lwamafilimu — vumela ukubuka kuqala (pre-vis) ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imali ekukhiqizweni kokugcina.
keyFeatures: Isigaba Sokuhlela Uchungechunge lwe-SFAI → Isigaba Sokwakha Uhlaka lwe-SFAI → Isigaba Sokukhiqiza se-SFAI → Isigaba Sokubukisa se-SFAI
Ukugunyazwa okugxile ezigabeni (beats) — i-pre-vis kanye ne-Shot Frames ngaphambi kwe-F2V
Ukukhiqizwa kwe-Google Vertex AI kusetshenziswa amaketanga okwandisa (extension chains) e-Veo angaphakathi ohlelweni
Izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuphepha nokwethembeka kanye nobufakazi obuqinisekisiwe bemvelaphi ngesikhathi sokulethwa
items.screenshotSlot: Faka isithombe-skrini: Isithombe esikhulu sasekuqaleni (hero image) + umugqa ochaza inqubo ngendlela elula
items.videoSlot: Faka isiqeshana esingu-01:30: Hero → iphrojekthi entsha → Blueprint Room → Production Stage Shoot → Screening Room → Shicilela

items.title: Ukuzenzakalela Kochungechunge
items.description: Chaza umhlaba wakho kanye bese udala izindaba ezihambisanayo ezihlanganisa iziqephu eziningi. Ukusebenzisa i-Reference Library ngokuhlanganyela kuqinisekisa ukuthi abalingiswa nesimo sendaba kuhlala kuhambisana kuso sonke isizini.
keyFeatures: Chaza umhlaba wakho kanye kuphela — abalingiswa, isimo, kanye nohlelo lwendaba lwesizini.
Izinhlaka zeziqephu ezihleleke kahle — ezikhiqizwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuso sonke isizini
Ukulandelela ukuqhubeka — ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziqephu zezinkathi eziningi ziyahambisana
Ukuvumelanisa uchungechunge neziqephu — ku-Blueprint Room naku-Production Stage
items.screenshotSlot: Faka isithombe-skrini: Uhlolojikelele lochungechunge kanye nezinhlaka zeziqephu ezikhiqizwe ngokuzenzakalelayo
items.videoSlot: Faka isiqeshana esithatha imizuzwana engama-30: Umqondo owandiswa ube yisizini eneziqephu eziningi

items.title: Ukuzenzakalela kwe-Blueprint Room
items.description: Guqula imiqondo ibe yizinhlaka ezihleliwe ezihlanganisa isifinyezo sendaba (logline), izigaba ezibalulekile (beats), abalingiswa, kanye nesimo sendaba (tone). Sebenzisa i-Audience Resonance futhi usebenzisane nabanye ngaphambi kokuqala inqubo enzima yokukhiqiza isithombe sokugcina (rendering).
keyFeatures: Khiqiza → Buyekeza → Lungisa futhi uphinde → Iya kwinqubo yokusebenza ye-Production Stage
Ukusuka emcabangweni kuya esakhiweni ngemizuzu — isifinyezo sendaba, izigaba ezibalulekile, abalingiswa, kanye nomoya wendaba
Ukuthola amaphuzu ku-Audience Resonance okuhloswe kuwo ukuba ngama-80 noma ngaphezulu ngaphambi kwe-Production Stage
Izixhumanisi zokwabelana zabahlanganyeli — ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono ukuze kwenziwe ukulungisa okuqondisiwe
items.screenshotSlot: Faka isithombe-skrini: I-Blueprint ekhiqizwe ngokuzenzakalelayo equkethe izigaba ezibalulekile zendaba kanye nokuguquka kwabalingiswa
items.videoSlot: Faka isiqeshana esithatha imizuzwana engama-30: Ukuguqula umqondo ube yi-Blueprint ehleliwe

items.title: Kwabelwane nge-Reference Library ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka
items.description: Qinisekisa ukuthi abalingiswa, izingubo, amazwi, izindawo, kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswayo kuhlala kungaguquki kuzo zonke izigcawu neziqephu ngokusebenzisa izinkomba ezingasetshenziswa kabusha.
keyFeatures: Amaphrofayili angasetshenziswa kabusha — abalingiswa, izingubo, amazwi, izindawo, kanye nezinsiza-kusebenza
Ukusetshenziswa ezimweni ezahlukene — izinkomba zigelezela esizukulwaneni ngasinye

audienceResonance.title: Audience Resonance: yakhela isiko, hhayi ikhodi yolimi
audienceResonance.description: Imibhalo engezansi yandisa ukufinyelela kwevidiyo eyodwa. I-SceneFlow ikuvumela ukuthi uchaze isiko, isifunda, kanye nohlobo lwezethameli ozenzela umsebenzi, uhlole indaba ngokuhambisana nalezo zethameli ngaphambi kokukhiqiza umkhiqizo wokugcina, bese ukhipha kungaba yinguqulo enamazwi abizwe kabusha (dubbed master) noma inguqulo ehlukile ehambisana kakhulu nezethameli ezithile.
bullets: Chaza izethameli: izifunda eziyisishiyagalombili okuhloswe ngazo, kanye nobudala, ubulili, imfundo kanye nomphakathi.
Chaza isiko, ukholo, kanye nezindinganiso ngamazwi akho — i-SceneFlow ifunda izimpawu.
Thola amaphuzu okusebenza kahle kanye neziphakamiso zokulungisa izingxenye ezithile ngaphambi kokuba uchithe imali ekwenzeni izithombe zokugcina (ama-render).
Yenza inguqulo eyinhloko (master), noma ukhiqize inguqulo ehlukile ehambisana nezethameli ngazinye.

howWeScore.title: Indlela i-Audience Resonance esebenza ngayo
howWeScore.description: I-Audience Resonance ihlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwesakhiwo sendaba (ukucaca, isivinini sokuhamba kwendaba, kanye nokushintsha kwemizwa) nokuhambisana nohlobo lwezithameli ozichaze ku-Blueprint — hhayi izibalo ezingabalulekile noma imininingwane yokuthi abantu baqhubeka kanjani nokubuka ngemuva kokushicilelwa. Uma incazelo yezithameli zakho iqukethe izici zamasiko, ukuhlaziya kuqinisekisa ukuthi amagama, izindlela zokukhuluma, amasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezindaba ezibucayi kuvezwa ngendlela eyiyo neyiqiniso. Izincomo zihlotshaniswa nezingxenye ezithile zombhalo ukuze ukwazi ukulungisa izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba ama-ejenti aqale ukukhiqiza ividiyo.
bullets: Ihlola i-Blueprint kanye nombhalo ngokuhambisana nezithameli oziqondisile.
Ukuhlolwa kokuba yiqiniso ngokwesiko maqondana namagama, izinhlobo zolimi, amasiko, inkolo, kanye nezindaba ezithinta imizwa yabantu
Izincomo ezisezingeni lesigaba — hhayi inombolo engacacile edinga ukuthi "usithembe" nje
Yenza lokhu ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imali eningi ekwenzeni i-render, hhayi ngemuva kokushicilela.

preVisEngine.title: I-Pre-Visualization Engine
preVisEngine.subtitle: Ukukhiqiza i-Pre-Vis (noma i-animatic, njengoba ibizwa kanjalo embonini) ethatha imizuzu engu-40, enamazwi aphelele nomculo, ngemizuzu engu-15 akuyona nje isinyathelo sokusebenza — kodwa kuwumkhiqizo uqobo. E-Hollywood, i-pre-vis ithatha amasonto amaningi futhi ibiza izinkulungwane eziningi zamadola; kanti ngale ndlela entsha, kuthatha imizuzu embalwa kuphela futhi kubiza imali encane kakhulu.
preVisEngine.narrative: Embonini yamafilimu, i-storyboard yinto oyinikeza ithimba lokusebenza. I-Pre-vis yinto oyikhombisa abaphathi besitudiyo, abatshali-zimali, kanye nabakhiqizi ukuze uthole imvume yokuqala iphrojekthi. I-SceneFlow iphakamisa izinga lokukhiqiza lisuka ekubeni ithuluzi nje labadali abazimele liye ekubeni yingxenye ebalulekile yohlelo lokusebenza lwezinga lebhizinisi.

pillars.title: Isethulo Sebhizinisi Esiphelele
pillars.description: Layisha umbhalo bese ungena emhlanganweni wokwethula iphrojekthi uphethe uhlaka olubonakalayo lwangaphambi kokukhiqiza (pre-vis) oluhlanganisa amazwi, umculo, nezilimi eziningi, kanye nedatha eqinile evela ku-Audience Resonance. Nikeza abadali indlela esheshayo nephumelelayo — esekelwe kudatha kanye nezinto ezibonakalayo nezizwakalayo — yokwenza amafilimu abo.

pillars.title: Isigaba Sangaphambi Kokukhiqiza Esivumela Ukuthola Amaphutha Ngokushesha
pillars.description: Indlela evamile yokwenza uhlaka lokuqala lwevidiyo (pre-visualization) idinga ochwepheshe bokugqwayiza nge-3D, abadwebi bezithombe ezichaza ukulandelana kwezigcawu, kanye nabalingisi bamazwi isikhathi esingamasonto amaningi. Uma isigcawu singaphumeleli, kuchithwa izinkulungwane eziningi zamadola. Ungenza izinguquko nokulungisa uhlaka kungakapheli imizuzu engu-15, ngaphambi kokuba kuqashwe ngisho nelungu elilodwa lethimba lekhamera.

pillars.title: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezindaba Zezezimali
pillars.description: Lokhu kuheha ingxenye yomkhakha eqaphe kakhulu mayelana nobungozi: abaxhasi bezimali. Khombisa ukuthi isivinini sokuhamba kwendaba, isimo sayo, kanye nezingxoxo kuhambisana kanjani nezethameli ezihlosiwe ngaphambi kokuba kuchithwe ngisho idola elilodwa ekukhiqizeni.

workflow.title: Reference Library → Ukubuka kuqala (Pre-Vis) → Ividiyo enyakazayo → Ifayela eliyinhloko le-ProRes 4K
steps: Yakha umtapo wolwazi lwezinkomba — okuhlanganisa abalingiswa, izindawo, kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswayo ezihambisana nesitayela sobuciko somkhiqizo wakho.

Dala izithombe zokuqala (pre-vis) zesigaba ngasinye esinezinkulumo, imiphumela yomsindo (SFX), nomculo — futhi ulungise indlela yokukhiqiza ngaphakathi kwegumbi lokubuka (screening room) ngendlela engabizi.
Vumela uhlaka oluyisibonelo (Pre-Vis), bese ukhiqiza ividiyo enyakazayo yesigcawu ngasinye enokufakwa kwamazwi ngezilimi eziningi kanye nokulungiswa okwenziwa ezingeni lesigcawu.
Thumela ifayela eliyinhloko le-Prores 4K elivela ku-Screening Room — likushicilele ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-YouTube noma ulande iphakethe.

forFilmmakers.heading: Kubenzi bamafilimu: Thumela isiqephu sakho sokuqala (pilot) ukuze sisatshalaliswe futhi sikhiqize imali ezinkundleni zokusakaza.
forFilmmakers.subtitle: Inethiwekhi ye-SceneFlow iyingxube ekhethekile yabadali abangamaphayona — ihlanganisa imisebenzi ekhethwe ngokucophelela ephakathi kwemihlanu neshumi ekuqaleni kwayo, hhayi imakethe evulekile. Ukwabelana ngemali engenayo kuqala kuphela uma sekukhona ababhalisile abakhokhayo. Esikunikezayo manje yithuba elingcono lokusabalalisa umsebenzi: izikhangiso ezifushane (ama-teaser) ezixhaswe ngezimali, ngokushintshisana ngelungelo lokuba umsebenzi uqale ukukhonjiswa lapha kuphela okokuqala ngqa.
forFilmmakers.closedNote: Izicelo zibuyekezwa ngabahleli. Ukuthumela akusho ukuthi ifilimu yakho izoshicilelwa ohlwini.
